resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code supporting GGA-PBE.
Standard PBE pseudopotentials (UPF format) for Sc, Al, Ga, In, Tl, C.

Space group, atomic positions, and approximate lattice parameters for Sc2AC (Cr2AlC prototype, P63/mmc, #194), ScC (NaCl, Fm-3m), Sc (hcp), C (graphite), and the ground-state structures of Al, Ga, In, Tl. Obtainable from public databases such as ICSD or the Materials Project.
